svg.text: What phase 3 trials are recruiting for type 2 diabetes?
Reviewer flagged 2 issues the revision did not resolve
NCT03925714 recruits prediabetic subjects, not patients with confirmed type 2 diabetes.
NCT06825182 inclusion criteria may be described too broadly.
Three phase 3 trials are currently recruiting for type 2 diabetes:
investigates the impact of p53 and SIRT1 in type 2 diabetes. Its inclusion
evaluates the efficacy and safety of UBT251 injection in adults with type 2
diabetes and inadequate glycemic control on diet and exercise alone.
Investigating the impact of p53 and SIRT1 in the development of type 2 DM
Current status of islet alpha cell function in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
Phase III study of UBT251 injection in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus with inadequate glycemic
control on diet and exercise alone
